kind: TXT1 minimum v2 interface proposal; awaiting Main GO before product edits
user_direction: Main reports explicit user choice B; no new paid allowance

select_blueprint.signature: select_blueprint(room_count, difficulty, *, seed=None) -> existing frozen Blueprint with content_version='2.0.0'
select_blueprint.behavior: Call the original pure selector exactly once, then dataclasses.replace only content_version. Preserve families, blueprint_id, rooms, objects, puzzles, references, slots, parameter domains and randomness/seed policy. Do not add structure variants.

content_schema.signature: content_schema(blueprint) -> fresh strict JSON Schema for the chosen v2 Blueprint
content_schema.behavior: Require a v2 Blueprint; reuse the fresh v1 schema representation. Change only content_version const to2.0.0 and objects value-schema to exact name-only. Keep rooms exact name/description, all other root fields, typed parameters, integer/permutation constraints and slot sets unchanged. Add local $defs/object_name alongside the original room text definition.

request_manifest.behavior: Require a v2 Blueprint; reuse original pure manifest, changing only content_version and text_rule to state name-only objects and Host description authority. Retain actual-reference item_use metadata and parameter meanings. No answers, solver output or parameter values in Host descriptions.

assemble_draft.signature: assemble_draft(blueprint, raw_model_content) -> original complete Draft dict
steps: Require the same selected immutable v2 Blueprint used by GenerationService.messages.
Run original strict_json against the untouched raw reply, retaining size/depth/unsafe/duplicate/nonfinite protections, then strict v2 exact-key/type/domain validation.
On any invalid v2, raise ValueError immediately. Never pass a failed v2 or a model v1 reply to a v1 fallback; never drop forbidden objects.description.

Only after successful v2 validation, construct a separate declared Host-internal helper input: all accepted fields/parameter values preserved, each object contains its accepted name plus a Host-generated description, and an internal v1 helper-format version tag.

Call the original pure v1 assemble_draft only on that Host-constructed complete helper value, using the same frozen structural Blueprint. This reuses structure/fact assembly rather than copying it. The helper-format tag is internal; the accepted model contract remains2.0.0.
Return the complete original Draft to the unchanged worker; no compile/proof call inside assembly, no raw mutation, defaults, repair, retry or provider calls.

interfaces.messages_handoff: Main keeps GenerationService.messages/generate in AI/v5.py: import these four current v2 functions, select one Blueprint per generate, pass that same instance explicitly to messages and assembly, retain legacy draft_schema caller compatibility. No new messages implementation in the Backend module.

host_description_policy.permitted_inputs: Only trusted Blueprint ObjectSlot/PuzzleSlot roles, mechanisms, recipes, actual references and validated generated object names. The description helper has no parameters/answers/witness/solver argument.
host_description_policy.item: Generic take-to-inventory and retain-after-use fact. An item puzzle resolves required_item_id to actual kind=item ObjectSlot, then references that object's accepted name; never hardcode obj_key, G1 or list order.
host_description_policy.clues: Distinguish position-family digit/device source from mapping-family symbol source; label position table, symbol correspondence, and extra digit/device fragments correctly. Never assert alphabetic sorting. Extra fragments get type identity, not an early first/second combination order.
host_description_policy.puzzles: Short truthful base role descriptions for code/sequence/circuit/item; leave the existing visible_state recipe/circuit/nonconsumption instruction suffix in place to avoid duplicating that full text.
host_description_policy.discovery_boundary: No secret values, complete answers, correct device order, future-room detail or undiscovered clue IDs in new base descriptions. Existing observed-object/all-clues-discovered combination-order gate and notebook facts remain unchanged.
host_description_policy.inspect: The saved base description is itself truthful when inspect returns it; the object-list projection may append the already-existing deterministic instruction, without any GeneratedRules edit.

version_compatibility.model_content_version: 2.0.0; removal of required object description is a breaking internal-output change
version_compatibility.blueprint_family_versions: position_v1/mapping_v1 unchanged; these identify existing structural families, independently of model content version
version_compatibility.old_contract: Original blueprints.py, v1 schema/builder/README remain byte-identical and independently rebuildable
version_compatibility.old_levels: Saved complete definitions and their text/hash are not regenerated or migrated through v2; no old raw/evidence rewriting
version_compatibility.evidence: Future authorized validation binds original model raw hash and content contract version separately; no new persistent DB fields/logging

explicit_frozen_paths: API/Store/provider/companion/assets/old tests and all old raw/evidence/databases/environments
owner_local_development_proposal: Read/hash/AST provenance check of explicit frozen sources; new v2 builder creates18 local-ref variants and --check, old v1 builder --check without rewriting it.
18 pure schema/assembly cases demonstrate exact v2 slots and old structural/parameter projection equality, excluding only newly authorized descriptions.
Focused v2 negatives: old version, objects.description, missing/extra slots, type/permutation errors, duplicate JSON keys, unsafe text and raw limits; no fallback on rejection.

Two representative family hard cases cover all roles/four mechanisms/three recipes/extra fragments; renamed actual item plus decoy, deterministic/fresh output, raw/Blueprint/schema nonmutation and maximum-length names.

Only necessary representative original compile/witness smoke if Main approves, rather than repeating the unchanged full structural/proof matrix. Independent formal QA remains after stable source stop/Main freeze.
risks_and_limits: The internal helper adaptation must be visibly after successful v2 validation; accepting raw v1 or silently discarding a model description would violate the design.
Names, story and room atmosphere remain AI text and may still imply wrong operations or facts; no arbitrary semantic correctness guarantee.
Finite templates may repeat. No synonym randomization or new structure-diversity implementation is proposed.
Original compiler answer-in-prose and all safety/admission checks stay final authority; valid schema alone does not establish admission or narrative quality.
No API/DB/network/provider/Key/config/ledger/private-proof read or paid call in current interface planning.

actual_read_commands.scope: Read selected proposal, original blueprints and relevant generated rules/AGENTS; no product execution
